title: 공군미사일방어사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:28266:20170905:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act <Presidential Decree No. 28266, September 5, 2017>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. [Proviso omitted.]
Articles 2 and 3
Omitted.
Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (7) Omitted.
(8) Part of the Decree on the Air Force Air Defense Guided Missile Command shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3 (2), "general-grade officer (將官級)" shall be replaced with "general officer (將星級)", and "general-grade officer or" shall be replaced with "general officer or".
(9) through (90) Omitted.
